name: Asian Range Breakout (S-tier from strategy tier-list)
description: From a tier-list video ranking algorithmic strategies. The S-tier pick: markets cycle between consolidation and breakout; the Asian session forms a consolidated range, and the higher-volatility London session breaks it with strong moves and a high strike rate.
instrument: EURUSD (forex; strategy is session-based, needs a 24h market)

setup.description: Mark the Asian-session high/low (00:00-06:00 UTC). During the London window, go long on a break above the range high or short on a break below the range low, whichever triggers first.

entry.long: First London-window bar whose high breaks the Asian range high
entry.short: First London-window bar whose low breaks the Asian range low

exit.stop_loss: Opposite side of the Asian range
exit.take_profit: risk_reward multiple of the range size
exit.time_stop: Close of day if neither hit

A: Swing structure (trend-following, whipsaw-prone but big runners)
B: ICT variations (silver bullet, inverse FVGs — statistical edge but not exceptional)
Bollinger band squeeze breakout (new, promising, pending forward test)
D: Moving average crossover (filter only, garbage standalone)

notes: Interpreted directly by Claude (Opus) in-session — the pipeline's ANTHROPIC_API_KEY was unset. Bollinger squeeze (B-tier) implemented separately as a strategy-studio built-in with a walk-forward grid.
